verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an official MCP server that brings its behavioral data into AI tools like Claude, Cursor and OpenAI so users can ask questions in conversation and get answers without SQL. It also offers programmatic query paths: a Dashboard REST API returning chart data as JSON, event export, cohort APIs, and a published OpenAPI spec. Together these give an agent a documented way to answer growth questions from product data. Missing for 10: details of which queries and tools the MCP server exposes, evidence on data freshness ('live'), and any independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent answering growth questions this way.
